partner_result_applied.application: Extended the partner family D_tau=2 sigma I_4+(tau-2 sigma)vv^T from pure quadratics to arbitrary affine tilts and then to arbitrary ambient completions, retaining the density cap C_*/2=12.091519144980758...

new_results.statement: At fixed threshold L, a pure QFORM bound C/L in one dimension class implies the same bound for every affine tilt, by scale margin, epsilon-I regularization, completion of the square, and weak-limit domination.

Assuming the full theorem below dimension n, an n-dimensional matrix is inherited whenever (p_L-1)_+ +(q_L-1)_+ >=3. Hence >=5 total L-large eigenvalues, or >=4 of one sign, require no new n-dimensional argument.

Every ambient symmetric completion containing the account02/B12 physical 4x4 block D_tau has density cap C_*/2, regardless of all outside coefficients/cross couplings and thus regardless of additional smaller/larger eigenvalues of either sign.

unresolved_implication: Treat the seven irreducible large-eigenvalue signatures, especially mixed (3,1),(2,2),(1,3), by a universal original-coordinate ridge/grouped-bank/physical-block/cross-packet mechanism.
